description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the postponement of local government elections in the Polonnaruwa district. It specifically deals with election scheduling, funding issues for conducting elections, and references the Election Commission - all of which fall under electoral processes and related matters, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
